note: The one third-party tool that builds ForgeSetup.exe, and how it is pinned. CI downloads the two packages by these URLs, refuses any whose size or SHA-256 differs, and installs them; the builder then refuses a makensis whose binary, data directory (stubs, plug-ins, includes) or reported version is not the pinned one. The SHA-256 values are those of the signed Ubuntu 24.04 archive index (suite noble, signature checked with the Ubuntu archive keyring when the pins were made). If the archive stops serving a package, the CI download fails and the pins are renewed on purpose.
